author: ojiudezue
title: v5.94.2 shipped: Shell-cleanup parent-entry resolution hotfix — actually remove the empty coordinator shells
summary: Shell-cleanup parent-entry resolution hotfix — actually remove the empty coordinator shells
why: Tier-1 resolution hotfix. The shell-removal predicate was correct and safe but never ran: the call site read parent_entry_id from entry.data.get(CONF_INTEGRATION_ENTRY_ID), a field stamped only at migration-create time, and the live CM entry predates that stamping so its data lacks it, guarding the cleanup out. The fix adds a fallback that resolves the single INTEGRATION entry directly (verbatim reuse of the existing :4705 finder). No change to the deletion predicate/guards, so the proven property — a real populated CM-owned coordinator device can never be selected — is preserved. Nesting was already validated correct live in v5.94.1.
implications: Shipped DEVICE-SHELL-CLEANUP-1 at v5.94.2; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.94.2.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Post-restart: zero empty coordinator shells; exactly one coordinator_manager / security_coordinator / music_following_coordinator device; Whole House alone on the parent entry; real CM ~60 / Security ~21 / Music ~10 entities intact.

refs.release_notes: v5.94.1 fixed the nesting live but the empty-shell removal no-op'd because the CM entry (a pre-existing migration) lacks CONF_INTEGRATION_ENTRY_ID in its data, so parent_entry_id resolved to None. Fix: fall back to resolving the single ENTRY_TYPE_INTEGRATION entry directly. Safety predicate + guards unchanged (already reviewed + mutation-verified in v5.94.1).
